approval: Maintainer approved replacing v1 with window scaling, landing on the PR #239 branch, and a USD 8 GPU cap.
why_v1_was_superseded: Direct CUPTI enabled at process start (model load and warmup included) while Kineto, Proton and nsys started after warmup, so the capture windows never matched.
Resource sampling ended with the measured window, before stop_profile, so profiler export and final flush memory were never observed.
The client process was recorded as the collector helper; the CUPTI collector runs inside the target processes.
One fixed 220 s window cannot show how collection cost scales; Kineto failing to export that window was scored as a missing denominator instead of an observation.
Only eager vLLM was tested, although graph replay is a decision-critical field.
question: Does a streaming direct-CUPTI Activity collector give bounded collection cost on long windows, with trace fidelity equal to Nsight, where vLLM's Kineto profiler (itself a CUPTI client) does not?

hypotheses.H1_cost_scaling: Kineto target-tree peak RSS growth and stop/export time grow with window length; direct CUPTI peak RSS growth stays bounded and its stop time stays roughly flat.
hypotheses.H2_perturbation: At equal windows, cupti-min window p95 latency perturbation over off is no higher than Kineto's.
hypotheses.H3_fidelity: cupti-min kernel populations match Nsight Systems in eager and CUDA-graph execution, with at least 99% of kernels correlated to a runtime launch.
hypotheses.H4_loss_visibility: Under induced pressure (small buffers, slow consumer) the collector reports drops instead of losing records silently.

decision_rule.adopt: H1 shows bounded CUPTI memory where Kineto grows or fails, H3 passes including CUDA graphs, H4 passes, and cupti-min median window p95 perturbation is at most 5% at the largest window.
decision_rule.defer: Fidelity passes but there is no cost advantage at windows Stormlog needs.
decision_rule.reject: Eager or graph fidelity fails, or cupti-min perturbation is clearly worse than Kineto's at equal windows.
decision_rule.scope: An adopt decision means an opt-in, experimental Linux NVIDIA collector only. AMD, macOS and Windows stay unqualified (issue #235).

workload.server: single L4, eager unless the trial says cuda_graphs, prefix caching off, fresh server per trial

window_scaling.window_definition: capture starts with measured load and stops W * 0.1 s later; requests keep arriving after the stop
window_scaling.order: seeded shuffle (seed 118) of all trials, one server per trial
window_scaling.timeout_rule: A stop that does not return within the timeout is recorded as an outcome for that mode and window, never dropped.
window_scaling.kineto_config: stack-free, record_shapes, memory and flops off; vLLM default gzip export retained and recorded
metrics: target-tree RSS: baseline median, peak per phase (window, stopping, settle), added peak over baseline
GPU memory per phase from nvidia-smi
CUPTI activity buffer peak outstanding bytes and completion-callback CPU seconds
artifact bytes and delivered and dropped records
window and after-window e2e p50/p95/p99 and TTFT over successful requests
target CPU seconds from capture start to end
window_scaling.reporting: min, median and max across repetitions; no bootstrap claim from three repetitions

fidelity.microbenchmarks: scripts/native_probes/workloads/cuda_microbench.py W1 eager, W2 overlap and serialized, W3 graph, 100 warmup and 1000 measured iterations; cupti-min and nsys in separate runs
fidelity.vllm_graph_mode: cuda_graphs trials at W=200 for cupti-min and nsys
fidelity.comparison: kernel counts by name, kernel-to-runtime correlation coverage, stream overlap and graph node kernel counts
fidelity.loss: W4 stress with a 64 KiB buffer and consumer delay; reported drops must be nonzero and visible in status
fidelity.coexistence: one nsys plus cupti-min run to confirm the single-subscriber failure is reported

budget.rule: pause after each phase; stop and report if projected spend exceeds the cap

amendments_before_window_scaling.change: cupti-min activity set is runtime,driver,kernel (was runtime,kernel)
amendments_before_window_scaling.evidence: Smoke: with runtime,kernel only 70.8% of vLLM kernels correlated; cuBLASLt/cutlass and Triton kernels launch through the driver API. With driver records correlation was 99.999%.

amendments_before_window_scaling.change: The helper links the CUPTI that matches the target's CUDA runtime (CUPTI 13.0.85 from the venv for torch cu130); the toolkit CUPTI 12.6 build is kept only as a negative control
amendments_before_window_scaling.evidence: With CUPTI 12.6 under the CUDA 13 runtime, about 39% of kernel records had zero device timestamps while CUPTI reported 0 dropped records, in every device-buffer, pool-limit and flush-period setting tried. With CUPTI 13.0 the count was 0.

amendments_before_window_scaling.change: Helper finalization disables activities before the final flush and counts records delivered after close as local drops; status reports kernels_without_timestamps
amendments_before_window_scaling.evidence: CUPTI 13 trial delivered 804 records after the trace was closed (EBADF).

amendments_before_window_scaling.change: Target-tree RSS cap of 80 GiB; exceeding it kills the server and is recorded as the trial outcome
amendments_before_window_scaling.evidence: Kineto added 1.8 GiB for a 5 s window in the smoke; a 220 s window could exhaust host memory if growth is linear.

amendments_before_window_scaling.change: Report Kineto's stop stall separately from in-capture overhead
amendments_before_window_scaling.evidence: Kineto stop_profile blocked serving for 33.5 s in the smoke, so window p95 reached 34 s.

prediction_recorded_before_window_scalin: Maintainer predicted: Kineto added RSS grows about 10x from W=200 to W=2200; CUPTI stays flat.

posthoc_additions.purpose: Separate CUPTI API-tracing cost from the helper's consumer cost: cupti-kernel (kernel activity only) and cupti-discard (runtime,driver,kernel with records counted and discarded), W=200, 3 repetitions; off baseline from the window-scaling plan.
Perturbation in vLLM CUDA-graph mode: off, cupti-min and cupti-kernel at W=200, 3 repetitions.
posthoc_additions.decision_role: explanatory only; does not change the pre-declared decision

posthoc_additions.note: The first run crashed on a duplicate environment key in the output-limit loss case (runs/micro); the fixed rerun is runs/micro2 and is the one reported.

manual_trials.purpose: First run with the helper linked to CUPTI 13.0.
manual_trials.outcome: 0 kernels without timestamps; the capture failed with 804 records delivered after the trace was closed (EBADF), which led to the finalization fix.

manual_trials.purpose: Recheck after the finalization fix (helper symlink pointing at the CUPTI 13.0 build).
manual_trials.outcome: Clean finalize, 0 drops, 0 kernels without timestamps.
Clean finalize, 0 drops, 0 kernels without timestamps.
